sentences.japanese: 空はどんよりとした冬の陰にかすんでいる。
sentences.english: The sky is a hazy shade of winter.
When you take shelter, make sure you go under a big tree.

sentences.japanese: 陰で他の人の悪口を言ってはならない。
sentences.english: We must not speak ill of others behind their backs.

sentences.japanese: 雲の陰に隠れて月は見えません。
sentences.english: The moon is invisible behind the clouds.

sentences.japanese: 雨が降って、その秋の日を陰うつにした。
sentences.english: The rain made the autumn day dismal.
